title: (RHBA-2020:4308) Update to Fuse 7.7.0 images
portal_summary: Updated fuse container images are now available for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
The RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com. Installation instructions for your platform are available at Red Hat Container Catalog (see References).

Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to this new image specifically, or to the latest image generally.
portal_description: The Fuse 7.7 container images have been updated for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers to support the new operator metadata format required by OpenShift 4.6.
abstract: The Fuse 7.7 container images have been updated for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers to support the new operator metadata format required by OpenShift 4.6.
